classes.label: Research Subject
classes.definition: De-identified adult subject whose longitudinal CKD data are represented.

classes.label: Care Context
classes.definition: Care setting and eligibility context associated with an observation, state or decision.

classes.label: Clinical State
classes.definition: Clinically meaningful state asserted for a subject over a stated interval.

classes.label: CKD State
classes.definition: Established CKD state with cause, GFR category, albuminuria category and chronicity context.

classes.label: GFR Categorical State
classes.definition: GFR category state.
classes.allowed_values: G1; G2; G3a; G3b; G4; G5

classes.label: Albuminuria Categorical State
classes.definition: Albuminuria category state.

classes.label: KDIGO CGA Risk Category
classes.definition: Native four-level CGA risk category.

classes.label: MR Testing Risk Category
classes.definition: Derived three-level category used only to limit ordinal MR test-space size.

classes.label: CKD Etiology Category
classes.definition: Broad cause/etiology qualifier when available.

classes.label: Established CKD Eligibility State
classes.definition: R1.0 release-population eligibility state.

classes.label: Clinical Observation
classes.definition: Measured or recorded clinical observation with value and temporal metadata.

classes.label: Kidney Function Observation
classes.definition: Observation reflecting kidney filtration/function.

classes.label: Albuminuria Observation
classes.definition: Urinary albumin measurement used for A-category state or change assessment.

classes.label: Observation Validity Assessment
classes.definition: Assessment of whether an observation is usable for a rule or trajectory.

classes.label: Observation Availability State
classes.definition: Availability state used for missingness and result-delay testing.

classes.label: Measurement Method Context
classes.definition: Method/specimen context required to interpret or map an observation.

classes.label: Temporal Entity
classes.definition: Entity with time-point, interval, duration, ordering or persistence semantics.

classes.label: Trajectory
classes.definition: Ordered longitudinal abstraction derived from observations.

classes.label: Observation Sequence
classes.definition: Time-ordered sequence of comparable observations.

classes.label: Baseline Observation Context
classes.definition: Baseline selection context used by a trajectory or outcome.

classes.label: Follow-up Observation Context
classes.definition: Follow-up observation context linked to a baseline.

classes.label: Early-warning eGFR Change
classes.definition: Subsequent-test eGFR decline >20% represented as an evaluation trigger.

classes.label: Confirmed Sustained eGFR Decline
classes.definition: Proposed D1 outcome: >=40% decline, second valid measurement >=90 days later, no intervening transient exception.

classes.label: Albuminuria Change Trajectory
classes.definition: Longitudinal ACR change including a doubling evaluation qualifier.

classes.label: Stable Kidney Function Trajectory
classes.definition: Trajectory satisfying a declared stability definition.

classes.label: Clinical Event
classes.definition: Temporally bounded event that may alter interpretation of a state or trajectory.

classes.label: AKI-like Transient Deterioration
classes.definition: Operational acute deterioration triggered by >20% eGFR decline and reversing before D1 persistence.

classes.label: Recovery Event
classes.definition: Observed recovery terminating or qualifying a transient deterioration.

classes.label: Sampling Pattern
classes.definition: Pattern of visit/observation density, gaps and redundancy.

classes.label: Medication Exposure Event
classes.definition: Start, stop or dose-change event for a medication class relevant to trajectory interpretation.

classes.label: RAAS Inhibitor Exposure Event
classes.definition: ACE inhibitor or ARB exposure event.

classes.label: SGLT2 Inhibitor Exposure Event
classes.definition: SGLT2 inhibitor exposure event.

classes.label: Diuretic Exposure Event
classes.definition: Diuretic exposure event relevant to volume-related changes.

classes.label: NSAID Exposure Event
classes.definition: NSAID exposure event relevant to acute deterioration context.

classes.label: Therapy-associated GFR Reduction Evaluation
classes.definition: Evaluation state triggered when GFR reduction after hemodynamically active therapy exceeds 30%.

classes.label: Risk Assessment
classes.definition: Versioned numeric or categorical risk estimate.

classes.label: Progression Risk Assessment
classes.definition: D1 output for the selected sustained-decline target.

classes.label: Kidney Failure Risk Assessment
classes.definition: Absolute kidney-failure risk from a validated equation.

classes.label: Decision Artifact
classes.definition: Versioned output produced by a model or decision policy.

classes.label: Monitoring Recommendation
classes.definition: D2 policy output.

classes.label: Referral Support Decision
classes.definition: D3 advisory policy output.

classes.label: Referral Risk Criterion
classes.definition: Five-year kidney-failure risk criterion for D3.

classes.label: Referral CGA Condition
classes.definition: Selected eGFR/ACR referral condition extracted from Figure 48.

classes.label: Decision Rationale
classes.definition: Criterion-level explanation attached to a policy output.

classes.label: Decision Policy Version
classes.definition: Versioned policy used to produce D2 or D3 output.

classes.label: Guideline Knowledge Item
classes.definition: Source-linked recommendation, practice point, definition, figure/table proposition or expert interpretation.

classes.label: Guideline Source
classes.definition: Versioned source document or official guideline release.

classes.label: Recommendation Statement
classes.definition: Graded guideline recommendation.

classes.label: Practice Point Statement
classes.definition: KDIGO practice point.

classes.label: Figure-derived Proposition
classes.definition: Controlled proposition extracted from a guideline figure/table cell.

classes.label: Expert Interpretation
classes.definition: Documented operationalization not stated directly by the guideline.

classes.label: Governance Entity
classes.definition: Provenance, review, licensing, version and terminology-control entity.

classes.label: Provenance Record
classes.definition: Source, locator, extraction, encoding and change record.

classes.label: Clinical Review Record
classes.definition: Independent reviewer decision, rationale and adjudication status.

classes.label: Licensing Record
classes.definition: Internal/public use and redistribution status.

classes.label: Terminology Mapping
classes.definition: Mapping from local class/concept to a frozen terminology code/version.

classes.label: Release Record
classes.definition: KG release identifier, freeze date, checksum and supersession history.

classes.label: Rule Entity
classes.definition: Compiler-facing class used only in the executable-rule layer.

classes.label: Executable Clinical Rule
classes.definition: Source-linked proposition admitted to deterministic compilation.

classes.label: Rule Applicability
classes.definition: Population, care-setting and clinical-state applicability specification.

classes.label: Rule Antecedent
classes.definition: Computable condition set required before a rule applies.

classes.label: Expected Clinical Relation
classes.definition: Expected equality, monotonic, ordinal, bounded or decision-level relation.

classes.label: Rule Exception
classes.definition: Computable exception preventing or modifying rule execution.

classes.label: Compilation Eligibility Record
classes.definition: Evidence that source, computability, provenance, terminology, review and licensing gates were checked.

classes.label: Context-only Knowledge Item
classes.definition: Explicit designation that an item remains contextual and is not compiled.

classes.label: Excluded Knowledge Item
classes.definition: Out-of-scope item retained with an exclusion reason.

classes.label: Prediction Model Version
classes.definition: A versioned identifier for the specific D1 prediction model (algorithm, training-data snapshot and hyperparameters) that produced a ProgressionRiskAssessment instance.
classes.source: Author-added in the closure pass to remove the D1/D2/D3 provenance asymmetry (D2/D3 already had DecisionPolicyVersion).

datatype_properties.definition: Time the specimen was collected, when available; preferred ordering time for specimen-based lab observations.
Time an observation or record was entered/imported into the research representation; provenance only, must not replace clinical time.
datatype_properties.control: Added post-C3-005-closure via C3-006; exactly 1 cardinality.

axioms.axiom: The three decision-output classes are mutually disjoint.
axioms.reason: Prevents conflation of model and policy outputs.

axioms.axiom: The two risk-assessment classes are distinct.
The native and derived category systems are separate types linked by a versioned mapping.
axioms.reason: Prevents the three-level collapse being presented as KDIGO.

axioms.axiom: The operational transient flag cannot be inferred as a formal diagnosis.
Executable and non-executable dispositions are mutually exclusive.
R1.0 contains no referral-order class and cannot infer one.
Medication exposure classes cannot be decision outputs.
Every executable rule must have ProvenanceRecord and CompilationEligibilityRecord.
Risk >=3% alone is insufficient to create a referral-support output.
A >30% reduction creates an evaluation state, not an automatic benign/adverse classification.

temporal_relations.meaning: Entity ends before the other begins.
First interval ends exactly when second starts.
First starts earlier and ends inside second.
Effective/specimen times equal at available precision.
Issued time follows effective time for same observation.
Temporal entity intersects configured event window.
temporal_relations.characteristic: Symmetric at interval level; not transitive

compilation_gates.label: Source located
compilation_gates.question: Is a stable source and precise locator present?

compilation_gates.label: Scope matched
compilation_gates.question: Is the knowledge item within C3-002 decision/population scope?

compilation_gates.label: Computable
compilation_gates.question: Can the proposition be deterministically represented?

compilation_gates.label: Licensing allowed
compilation_gates.question: Can the required artefact be used in the target release?

compilation_gates.label: Review sufficient
compilation_gates.question: Has the required review tier been reached?

compilation_gates.label: Release integrity
compilation_gates.question: Are version, checksum and supersession metadata complete?

exception_types.label: ApplicabilityExclusion
exception_types.trigger: GFR category, care setting, age/population eligibility

exception_types.label: MissingDataException
exception_types.definition: Required observation or confirmation is absent.
exception_types.trigger: Missing baseline, missing confirmation, missing expected visit

exception_types.label: TemporalPrecisionException
exception_types.definition: Available time precision cannot prove temporal relation.

exception_types.label: MedicationContextException
exception_types.effect: Qualifies segment/default slope; no causation claim.

exception_types.label: TerminologyMappingException
exception_types.trigger: No safe mapping, unverified source convention
exception_types.effect: Use local concept or block external-dependent rule.

exception_types.label: LicensingReleaseException
exception_types.definition: Target release cannot expose/use restricted artefact.
exception_types.effect: Block release inclusion; local private use may differ.

exception_types.label: ReviewGateException
exception_types.definition: Required clinical/technical review is incomplete or rejected.

exception_types.label: ConflictException
exception_types.definition: Another applicable rule creates unresolved contradictory expectation.

conflict_types.label: ExpectedRelationConflict
conflict_types.condition: Same target/output, overlapping applicability, incompatible expected relations.
conflict_types.example: One rule expects increase; another expects decrease.

conflict_types.label: ApplicabilityConflict
conflict_types.condition: Two rules claim incompatible applicability for same snapshot.
conflict_types.example: Eligible vs excluded under same conditions.
conflict_types.resolution: Use more-specific declared scope only if approved.

conflict_types.label: ExceptionConflict
conflict_types.condition: Rule exception and rule antecedent both satisfied with unclear override.

conflict_types.label: VersionConflict
conflict_types.condition: Different active versions of same source/rule/mapping appear applicable.
conflict_types.resolution: Use release pin/current version; preserve superseded history.

conflict_types.label: TerminologyConflict
conflict_types.condition: Multiple candidate codes/mapping relations for same source value.
conflict_types.resolution: Use source applicability record; otherwise local-only/abstain.

conflict_types.label: DataConflict
conflict_types.condition: Concurrent source records disagree after selection/status rules.
conflict_types.example: Distinct final observations with incompatible values.
conflict_types.resolution: Apply frozen same-time rule; if still semantically unresolved, flag conflict.

conflict_types.label: TemporalConflict
conflict_types.condition: Temporal relations cannot be simultaneously satisfied or precision makes relation uncertain.
conflict_types.example: Event both before/overlaps under coarse time.
conflict_types.resolution: Three-valued evaluation; Indeterminate if not provable.

conflict_types.label: DecisionPolicyConflict
conflict_types.condition: D2/D3 policy versions produce contradictory recommendations.
conflict_types.example: Two current policy versions or overlapping local policies.
conflict_types.resolution: Use one release-pinned policy; unresolved -> abstain.

conflict_types.label: SourceInterpretationConflict
conflict_types.condition: Source statement and author interpretation disagree or two interpretations differ.
conflict_types.resolution: Source item remains authoritative; adjudicate interpretation.

conflict_types.label: ReviewConflict
conflict_types.condition: Independent reviewers disagree on clinical meaning/safety.
conflict_types.example: Reviewer A accept, reviewer B reject.

precedence_tiers.rule: Invalid/entered-in-error data and release-prohibited artefacts cannot support execution.
precedence_tiers.cannot_override: Cannot be overridden by rule strength or specificity.

precedence_tiers.rule: Out-of-scope subject/context makes the rule non-applicable.
precedence_tiers.cannot_override: Cannot be overridden by a more general rule.

precedence_tiers.rule: An exception suppresses/qualifies only the rule and scope it explicitly references.
Closed C3-008/C3-009 event and precision semantics determine whether a condition is TRUE/FALSE/INDETERMINATE.
A more-specific rule may outrank a generic rule only when scope containment is explicit and the expected relations are compatible with the approved policy.
precedence_tiers.cannot_override: Cannot be assumed from wording alone.

precedence_tiers.rule: Within one rule/mapping lineage, the release-pinned non-superseded version is current.
Used for unresolved same-tier or clinically meaningful conflicts.
Return ABSTAIN/INDETERMINATE and block eligible compilation where required.

temporal_entities.label: Temporal Instant
temporal_entities.definition: Single time point with declared precision.
temporal_entities.control: Represents an interval of possible instants when precision is coarse.

temporal_entities.label: Temporal Interval
temporal_entities.required_fields: start; end or open-end; boundary convention

temporal_entities.label: Temporal Duration
temporal_entities.required_fields: lexical duration; canonical numeric value where safe; unit
temporal_entities.control: Calendar month/year durations are not blindly converted to fixed days.

temporal_entities.label: Uncertain Time
temporal_entities.definition: Possible-time interval implied by partial precision.
temporal_entities.control: Relation executable only when truth is invariant across possibilities.

temporal_entities.label: Sequence Position
temporal_entities.definition: Deterministic ordering position after same-time tie-break.

prov:SourceArtifact: Frozen guideline, literature, dataset or design-control source.
prov:LiteratureSource: Versioned literature source used for evidence/working assumptions.
prov:ProvenanceActivity: Activity that extracts, interprets, maps, derives or executes an artefact.
prov:ExtractionActivity: Activity extracting a knowledge item from a source.
prov:InterpretationActivity: Activity creating an explicit operational interpretation.
prov:RuleDerivationActivity: Activity deriving an executable clinical rule.
prov:AdministrativeReviewRecord: Licensing, registration or public-sharing review record.
prov:ExecutionProvenanceRecord: Runtime provenance linking release, code, dataset snapshot and outputs.
term:TerminologyReleasePin: Pinned terminology edition/version for a mapping set.
kgmr:CompilationGateType: One of the eight frozen C3-012 compilation gates.
kgmr:ConflictResolutionRecord: Versioned record of a conflict, resolution or abstention.
kgmr:PrecedenceTier: One of the frozen P0-P8 precedence tiers.
